PDF.js 5.6.205 (Mozilla), licensed under Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.

Vendored browser build and worker from pdfjs-dist. The two bundled CMaps are required by the original 408 PDFs. Embedded fonts and system fallback fonts are used; WebAssembly is disabled.
